justification: Inspected `src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/Evaluator.java`, `src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/QueryParser.java`, `src/main/java/org/jsoup/nodes/Element.java`, `src/test/java/org/jsoup/select/EvaluatorTest.java`, and `src/test/java/org/jsoup/nodes/ElementTest.java`. `IndexEquals` is a small leaf nested class: it only extends `IndexEvaluator`, stores one `int`, and its `matches` method calls only `element.elementSiblingIndex()` plus `toString()`. Repository-wide references are limited to 2 production call sites (`QueryParser.parsePseudoSelector()` and `Element.getElementsByIndexEquals()`) and 2 tests, which is not evidence of hub-like high fan-in/fan-out.
